title: VoxGo v0.4.2
notes: Added in-app update downloads with SHA256 verification, install-and-restart, configuration/model preservation, and rollback on failure. Users upgrading from 0.4.1 must download manually once.
Added local offline Chinese/English translation with OPUS-MT models; download models once before offline use.
Fixed the Simplified Chinese target language token and added contextual game terminology rules. Translation quality remains limited for complex game dialogue.
Added resilient model download sources and bilingual update notes.
notes_en: Added in-app update downloads with SHA256 verification, install-and-restart, configuration/model preservation, and rollback on failure. Users upgrading from 0.4.1 must download manually once.

notes_zh: 新增应用内更新下载、SHA256 校验和安装重启，保留配置与模型，失败时回滚；0.4.1 用户首次升级仍需手动下载。
新增 OPUS-MT 中英双向本地离线翻译，首次下载模型后可断网使用。
修正简体中文目标语言标记，新增带语境判断的游戏术语规则；复杂游戏对话的翻译质量仍有限。
增强模型下载源容错，更新提示支持双语发布说明。
